title: Drake drills for oil
place: Cherrytree Township, near Titusville, Pennsylvania, United States
summary: Edwin Drake drilled a successful oil well in Pennsylvania.
why: Often called the first commercial oil well, though sites elsewhere also claim the title.

notes.problem: Why overclaims: source says 'often referred to as the first commercial oil well, although that title is also claimed' (incl. West Virginia, US). Well is in Cherrytree Township, ~3 miles south of Titusville.
